W_locus.natural_frequency: common polymorphism; reported up to approximately 0.5 allele frequency in reviews and 0-43% white-petal phenotype in Del Valle Table S1 source synthesis
W_locus.deleterious_pleiotropy: no comparable established deleterious fitness burden identified despite extensive study

A_locus.architecture: early structural flavonoid-pathway lesion with extra-floral pigmentation effects
A_locus.heat_cost: aa homozygotes show reduced male and female fertilization success versus AA at high but not low temperature

interpretation: Within one species and a similar white floral endpoint, regulatory versus early structural pathway architecture tracks a large difference in natural frequency and documented pleiotropic cost, consistent with floral-specific pigment decoupling.
hard_nonclaims: does not prove the W locus has zero pleiotropy
does not treat allele frequency and phenotype frequency as identical quantities
does not establish architecture as the sole cause of frequency differences
